requirements.requirement: The system must define a sponsor object schema containing fields: sponsor_name (string), sponsor_type (string), funding_source (enum: public|private|undisclosed), collaborators (array of strings), and score_contribution (number or string).
The system must ensure the schema supports multiple collaborators as an ordered array of strings.
The system must enforce funding_source values strictly to the allowed enum (public, private, undisclosed).
The system must define score_contribution as a field compatible with numeric scoring outputs from EVAL-CT-MEASURE-SPONSOR.
The system must ensure the schema is JSON-serializable and compatible with the MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline.
The system must include optional/null handling for collaborators when no collaborators are provided.
The system must include optional/null handling for funding_source when backend data is missing.
The system must validate that sponsor_name is a non-empty string when present.
The system must allow sponsor_type to accept predefined categories (e.g., industry, academic, government) as strings without breaking schema validation.
The system must maintain backward compatibility with existing trial response payloads that do not include sponsor data.
The system must define the schema contract in a reusable TypeScript interface or equivalent typed structure for frontend use.
The system must ensure field names in the schema exactly match the API response contract from EVAL-CT-MEASURE-SPONSOR.
The system must fail schema validation if funding_source contains a value outside the allowed enum.
The system must default funding_source to 'undisclosed' when the field is missing or null.
The system must ensure the schema supports extension with additional sponsor-related fields without breaking existing consumers.
